en.s: The Battle of Happrew was a skirmish which took place around 20 February 1304, during the First War of Scottish Independence. A chevauchée of English knights, which included Robert de Clifford, William de Latimer, and the later Scottish King, Robert the Bruce had been sent south from Dunfermline under Sir John Segrave to locate and capture the rebels Sir William Wallace and Sir Simon Fraser.

zh.s: 哈普鲁战役是第一次苏格兰独立战争期间，于1304年2月20日前后发生的一场小规模交战。约翰·西格雷夫爵士奉命率一支英格兰骑士部队从邓弗姆林南下，沿途进行骑兵袭掠，搜捕反抗者威廉·华莱士爵士和西蒙·弗雷泽爵士。部队成员包括罗伯特·德克利福德、威廉·德拉蒂默，以及后来成为苏格兰国王的罗伯特·布鲁斯。

en.s: The Battle of Hard was the first large-scale battle in the Swabian War, waged between the Imperials under the Holy Roman Emperor Maximilian I and the Swiss Confederates. The battle was fought on 20 February 1499, a cold and foggy day, between 10,000 Imperial troops, mostly from the Swabian Circles, and a smaller number of Swiss troops, often called Reisläufer. The battle took place in the westernmost part of modern-day Austria, in the vicinity of the southeast corner of Lake Constance, roughly southwest of the town of Bregenz. The Imperial army had deployed its advance guard between the towns of Lustenau and Höchst, south of the lake town of Hard.

zh.s: 哈尔德战役是施瓦本战争中的首场大规模战役，交战双方是神圣罗马帝国皇帝马克西米连一世麾下的帝国军与瑞士邦联军。1499年2月20日，天气寒冷、浓雾弥漫，约1万名主要来自施瓦本帝国行政圈的帝国军，与人数较少、常被称为瑞士雇佣兵的瑞士部队交战。战场位于今奥地利最西部、博登湖东南角附近，大致在布雷根茨镇西南方向。帝国军先头部队部署在湖畔哈尔德镇以南的卢斯特瑙与赫希斯特之间。

en.s: The Battle of Drumlanrig (1548) was a small but significant battle involving The Earl of Angus' forces intercepting a larger English force at Drumlanrig. The English defeat cost them much of their cavalry, which left the main army vulnerable to Scottish men at arms and borderers, who could now raid supply lines and the main English force at will, leaving them vulnerable forcing their retreat and liberating the Western Lowlands, which greatly helped Scotland win the war.

zh.s: 德拉姆兰里格之战（1548年）是一场规模不大但影响重大的战斗。安格斯伯爵率军在德拉姆兰里格截击一支规模更大的英军。英军战败并损失大部分骑兵，主力部队因此容易遭苏格兰步兵和边境居民袭击；后者得以随时袭击英军补给线和主力，迫使英军撤退、解放苏格兰西部低地。这大大助力苏格兰赢得战争。

en.s: The Battle of Elmina was a significant engagement that transpired during the Fourth Anglo-Dutch War. In this military encounter, British forces undertook an operation with the aim of capturing the strategic Elmina Fort. However, their efforts ended in failure, as the British were unable to secure control of the fortification.

en.t: The Postal Service Act, establishing the United States Post Office Department, is signed by United States President George Washington
en.s: The United States Post Office Department (USPOD; also known as the Post Office or U.S. Mail) was the predecessor of the United States Postal Service, established in 1792. From 1872 to 1971, it was officially in the form of a Cabinet department. It was headed by the postmaster general. The Postal Service Act, signed by U.S. president George Washington on February 20, 1792, established the department.

zh.t: 《邮政服务法》获签署，设立美国邮政部
zh.s: 美国邮政部（USPOD，也称邮政局或美国邮政）是美国邮政总局的前身，成立于1792年。1872年至1971年间，它是内阁部门，由邮政部长领导。美国总统乔治·华盛顿于1792年2月20日签署《邮政服务法》，设立了该部门。

en.s: The siege of San Fiorenzo (also known as the siege of Saint-Florent ) was a British and Corsican military operation conducted during the French Revolutionary Wars against the French-held town of San Fiorenzo on the Mediterranean island of Corsica. The Corsican people had risen up against the French Republican garrison in 1793 after an attempt to arrest the Corsican leader Pasquale Paoli during the Reign of Terror.

zh.s: 圣菲奥伦佐围城战又称圣弗洛朗围城战，是法国大革命战争期间英国和科西嘉军队对地中海科西嘉岛上法军控制的圣菲奥伦佐镇发动的一次军事行动。1793年，科西嘉人起义反抗法兰西共和国守军；此前，在恐怖统治时期，法方曾试图逮捕科西嘉领导人帕斯夸莱·保利。

en.s: The siege of El Arish was a successful siege by French forces under Napoleon Bonaparte against Ottoman forces under Mustafa Pasha. The French army, commanded by Jean Baptiste Kléber and Jean Reynier laid siege to the fortress of El Arish for nine days. The fortress finally fell to the French on 20 February 1799.

zh.s: 拿破仑·波拿巴率领法军围攻穆斯塔法帕夏指挥的奥斯曼军队，成功攻下阿里什。让-巴蒂斯特·克莱贝尔和让·雷尼耶率领的法军围攻阿里什要塞九天。1799年2月20日，要塞最终落入法军之手。

en.s: The Battle of Vich or Battle of Vic on 20 February 1810 saw a Spanish force under Henry O'Donnell suddenly attack a 5,500-man Imperial French division led by Joseph Souham. After bitter fighting the French prevailed, forcing O'Donnell's men to retreat. The engagement occurred during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars. Vic is located 60 kilometres (37 mi) north of Barcelona in the province of Catalonia. One month after his lieutenant Luis González Torres de Navarra, Marquess of Campoverde scored a victory in the Battle of Mollet, O'Donnell found that Souham's division was isolated at Vic.

zh.s: 1810年2月20日，亨利·奥唐奈率西班牙军队突袭约瑟夫·苏昂指挥、约5500人的法国帝国陆军师。激战后，法军获胜，迫使奥唐奈的部队撤退。这场战斗属于拿破仑战争中的半岛战争。维克位于加泰罗尼亚，距巴塞罗那以北约60公里，即37英里。此前一个月，奥唐奈的副将、坎波韦尔德侯爵路易斯·冈萨雷斯·托雷斯·德纳瓦拉刚在莫列特战役中取胜，随后奥唐奈发现苏昂的师孤立驻扎在维克。

en.s: The Battle of Salta took place on February 20, 1813 on the plains of Castañares, north of the present-day Argentina city of Salta, during the Argentine War of Independence. The Army of the North, under the command of general Manuel Belgrano, defeated for the second time the royalist troops of general Pío de Tristán, after their victory in the previous September at the Battle of Tucumán. The unconditional surrender of the royalist troops ensured Argentine control over most of the northern territories of the former Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata.

zh.s: 1813年2月20日，阿根廷独立战争期间，萨尔塔战役在今阿根廷萨尔塔市以北的卡斯塔尼亚雷斯平原发生。曼努埃尔·贝尔格拉诺将军率北方军，在此前一年9月赢得图库曼战役后，再次击败皮奥·德特里斯坦将军指挥的保王军。保王军无条件投降，使阿根廷得以控制原拉普拉塔总督辖区北部的大部分领土。

en.t: Capture of HMS Cyane and HMS Levant
en.s: The capture of HMS Cyane and HMS Levant was an action which took place at the end of the Anglo-American War of 1812. The British warships HMS Cyane and HMS Levant fought USS Constitution on 20 February 1815 about 100 miles east of Madeira. Following exchanges of broadsides and musket fire, both Cyane and Levant surrendered. The war had actually finished a few days before the action with the ratification of the Treaty of Ghent by both sides, but the combatants were not aware of this. Constitution and the two prizes anchored in Porto Praya in the Cape Verde islands.

zh.t: 英国军舰“西恩”号与“黎凡特”号被俘
zh.s: 1815年2月20日，英美1812年战争接近结束时，英国军舰“西恩”号与“黎凡特”号在马德拉岛以东约100英里处，与美国军舰“宪法”号交战。双方以舷炮和火枪互射后，两艘英舰均投降。事实上，双方早在几天前已批准《根特条约》，战争已经结束，但参战人员尚不知情。此后，“宪法”号及两艘被俘军舰停泊在佛得角群岛的普拉亚港。

en.t: Rossini’s Barber of Seville premieres in Rome
en.s: On 20 February 1816, Gioachino Rossini’s opera The Barber of Seville premiered at the Teatro Argentina in Rome, in present-day Italy. The first performance used the title Almaviva, or The Useless Precaution.

zh.t: 罗西尼歌剧《塞维利亚的理发师》在罗马首演
zh.s: 1816年2月20日，罗西尼的歌剧《塞维利亚的理发师》在今意大利罗马的阿根廷剧院首演，首演时使用的剧名是《阿尔马维瓦，或徒劳的防范》。

en.t: William Buckland presents Megalosaurus to the Geological Society
en.s: On 20 February 1824, William Buckland presented fossil bones to the Geological Society of London in the United Kingdom and named the animal Megalosaurus. It was the first dinosaur formally described; the term Dinosauria was introduced later.

zh.t: 威廉·巴克兰向伦敦地质学会介绍巨齿龙
zh.s: 1824年2月20日，威廉·巴克兰在英国伦敦地质学会介绍化石骨骼，将这种动物命名为巨齿龙。它是最早被正式科学描述的恐龙，“恐龙”这一分类名称则在后来才出现。

en.s: The Battle of Ituzaingó, also known as the Battle of Passo do Rosário, was a pitched battle fought in the vicinity of the Santa Maria River, in a valley of small hills where a stream divided the valley into two. After a two-year series of continuous sundry skirmishes in the Banda Oriental (present-day Uruguay and Rio Grande do Sul) and along the border of this region with Brazil, the advancing Argentine Army (including Orientals) engaged in combat with the Imperial Brazilian Army. The battle lasted for about six hours, beginning at around six in the morning of 20 February 1827.

zh.s: 伊图萨因戈战役，又称罗萨里奥渡口战役，发生在圣玛丽亚河附近一片丘陵间的山谷，一条溪流将山谷一分为二。此前两年，东岸地区，也就是今乌拉圭和南里奥格兰德，以及该地区与巴西接壤的边境一带，不断发生各类小规模交战。随后，向前推进的阿根廷军队，包括东岸地区部队，与巴西帝国军在此展开会战。战斗于1827年2月20日早晨约6点开始，持续约六小时。

en.s: The 1835 Concepción earthquake was an earthquake that occurred near the neighboring cities of Concepción and Talcahuano in Chile on 20 February at 11:30 local time (15:30 UTC), and had an estimated magnitude of about 8.5 Mw. The earthquake triggered a tsunami which caused the destruction of Talcahuano. A total of at least 50 people died from the effects of the earthquake and the tsunami.
en.n: The 1835 Concepción earthquake destroys Concepción, Chile.

zh.s: 1835年2月20日11:30（当地时间；协调世界时15:30），智利康塞普西翁和塔尔卡瓦诺两座相邻城市附近发生地震，矩震级估计约为8.5。地震引发海啸，摧毁了塔尔卡瓦诺。地震和海啸共造成至少50人死亡。
zh.n: 1835年康塞普西翁地震摧毁了智利康塞普西翁。

en.t: Polish insurgents in the Free City of Kraków led an uprising (depicted) attempting to incite a fight for national independence that was put down by the Austrian Empire nine days later
en.s: The Kraków Uprising (Polish: powstanie krakowskie, rewolucja krakowska; German: Krakauer Aufstand; Russian: краковское восстание, romanized: krakovskoye vosstaniye) of 1846 was an attempt, led by Polish insurgents such as Jan Tyssowski and Edward Dembowski, to incite a fight for national independence. The uprising was centered on the city of Kraków, the capital of the small Free City of Cracow.

zh.t: 克拉科夫自由市的波兰起义者发动起义，试图争取民族独立，九天后被奥地利帝国镇压
zh.s: 1846年的克拉科夫起义（波兰语：powstanie krakowskie、rewolucja krakowska；德语：Krakauer Aufstand；俄语：краковское восстание，转写：krakovskoye vosstaniye）由扬·蒂索夫斯基、爱德华·登宾斯基等波兰起义者领导，试图争取民族独立。起义以克拉科夫为中心；当时这座城市是小型克拉科夫自由市的首府。

en.t: Coro uprising begins Venezuela’s Federal War
en.s: On 20 February 1859, Tirso Salaverría occupied a military base in Coro, Venezuela, and proclaimed federal government and political reforms. The uprising marked the beginning of Venezuela’s Federal War.

zh.t: 科罗起义拉开委内瑞拉联邦战争序幕
zh.s: 1859年2月20日，蒂尔索·萨拉韦里亚占领委内瑞拉科罗的一处军事基地，宣布主张联邦制及政治改革。这次起义标志着委内瑞拉联邦战争的开始。

en.s: The Battle of Olustee or Battle of Ocean Pond was fought in Baker County, Florida on February 20, 1864, during the American Civil War. It was the only major battle fought in Florida during the war. Union General Truman Seymour had landed troops at Jacksonville, aiming chiefly to disrupt Confederate food-supply. Meeting little resistance, he proceeded towards the state capital Tallahassee, against orders, assuming that he would face only the small Florida militia. But the Confederates in Charleston had sent reinforcements under General Alfred H. Colquitt, and the two armies collided at Ocean Pond, where the Union was repulsed.

zh.s: 1864年2月20日，美国南北战争期间，佛罗里达州贝克县发生奥拉斯蒂战役，又称海洋池战役。这是战争期间佛罗里达境内唯一的一场主要战役。联邦军将领杜鲁门·西摩在杰克逊维尔登陆，主要目的是破坏邦联的粮食供应。由于几乎未遇抵抗，他违令向州首府塔拉哈西进军，以为只会遇到人数不多的佛罗里达民兵。但查尔斯顿的邦联军已派出阿尔弗雷德·H.科尔奎特将军率领的援军。双方在海洋池交战，联邦军被击退。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Myers was fought on February 20, 1865, in Lee County, Florida during the last months of the American Civil War. This small engagement is known as the "southernmost land battle of the Civil War." (However, see Battle of Palmito Ranch.)

zh.s: 1865年2月20日，美国南北战争的最后几个月中，佛罗里达州李县发生迈尔斯堡战役。这场小规模交战被称为“南北战争中位置最靠南的陆战”，不过这一说法还需结合帕尔米托牧场战役来看。

en.s: The Uruguayan War (10 August 1864 – 20 February 1865) was fought between Uruguay's governing Blanco Party and an alliance consisting of the Empire of Brazil and the Uruguayan Colorado Party, covertly supported by Argentina. Since its independence, Uruguay had been ravaged by intermittent struggles between the Colorado and Blanco factions, each attempting to seize and maintain power in turn.

zh.s: 乌拉圭战争发生于1864年8月10日至1865年2月20日，交战双方是乌拉圭执政的白党，以及巴西帝国和乌拉圭红党组成的联盟；联盟还得到阿根廷秘密支持。乌拉圭独立后，红党和白党时常发生冲突，轮流争夺并巩固政权。

en.s: The 1868 Victorian colonial election was held from 21 January to 20 February 1868 to elect the 6th Parliament of Victoria. All 78 seats in 49 electorates in the Legislative Assembly were up for election, though seven seats were uncontested. There were 24 single-member, 21 two-member and 4 three-member electorates.
en.n: The 1868 Victorian colonial election was held from 21 January to 20 February 1868 to elect the 6th Parliament of Victoria.

zh.s: 1868年维多利亚殖民地选举于1868年1月21日至2月20日举行，以选出维多利亚第六届议会。立法议会的49个选区共选出78名议员，其中7个席位因无人竞争而直接产生；选区包括24个单议席区、21个双议席区和4个三议席区。

en.t: Metropolitan Museum of Art opens to the public
en.s: On February 20, 1872, the Metropolitan Museum of Art opened to the public at 681 Fifth Avenue in New York City, United States. This was its first museum location, before its move to Central Park.

zh.t: 纽约大都会艺术博物馆首次对公众开放
zh.s: 1872年2月20日，美国纽约大都会艺术博物馆在第五大道681号首次对公众开放。这是博物馆最早的馆址，后来才迁往中央公园。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Germany on 20 February 1890. The Centre Party regained its position as the largest party in the Reichstag by winning 106 of the 397 seats, whilst the National Liberal Party, formerly the largest party, was reduced to 42 seats. Despite receiving the most votes, the Social Democratic Party won only 35 seats. Voter turnout was 71.5%.

zh.s: 德国于1890年2月20日举行国会选举。中央党在397个议席中赢得106席，重新成为国会第一大党；此前的第一大党民族自由党则降至42席。社会民主党虽然得票最多，却仅获得35席。投票率为71.5%。

en.s: The 20 February bombings, also known as the Rue Saint-Jacques and Faubourg Saint-Martin bombings were two bomb attacks carried out in Paris on 20 February 1894 by the anarchist militant Désiré Pauwels against the French police and state. Organized six days after the Café Terminus bombing, these attacks occurred during the latter phase of the Ère des attentats (1892–1894).

zh.s: 1894年2月20日，巴黎发生两起炸弹袭击，又称圣雅克街爆炸案和圣马丁郊区爆炸案。无政府主义激进分子德西雷·波维尔斯针对法国警察和国家发动了袭击。这两起爆炸案发生在特米纳斯咖啡馆爆炸案六天后，属于1892年至1894年“恐怖袭击时代”的后期。

en.s: The 1896 Waverley colonial by-election was held on 20 February 1896 to elect the member for Waverley in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly, following the death of Free Trade MP Angus Cameron. Thomas Jessep retained the seat for the Free Trade Party with a swing of 6.9% against Protectionist candidate Thomas Barlow and former premier Sir Henry Parkes, who contested the election as an independent.

zh.s: 1896年2月20日，新南威尔士立法议会韦弗利选区举行补选，起因是自由贸易党议员安格斯·卡梅伦去世。托马斯·杰塞普保住了自由贸易党在该选区的席位，支持率上升6.9个百分点，击败保护主义党候选人托马斯·巴洛，以及以独立候选人身份参选的前州长亨利·帕克斯爵士。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 20 February 1905. Supporters of Theodoros Deligiannis emerged as the largest bloc in Parliament, with 144 of the 235 seats. Deligiannis remained Prime Minister after the election, but died on 13 June and was succeeded by Dimitrios Rallis.

zh.s: 希腊于1905年2月20日举行议会选举。西奥多罗斯·德利扬尼斯的支持者在235个议席中赢得144席，成为议会最大阵营。德利扬尼斯在选后继续担任首相，但于6月13日去世，由季米特里奥斯·拉利斯接任。

en.t: US Supreme Court decides Jacobson v. Massachusetts
en.s: On February 20, 1905, the US Supreme Court upheld Massachusetts’s authority to require smallpox vaccination in Jacobson v. Massachusetts. The case concerned a fine for refusing vaccination; it did not authorize physically vaccinating every objector by force.

zh.t: 美国最高法院就雅各布森诉马萨诸塞州案作出裁决
zh.s: 1905年2月20日，美国最高法院在雅各布森诉马萨诸塞州案中，认可马萨诸塞州要求接种天花疫苗的权力。案件涉及拒绝接种后的罚款，并非授权对所有拒绝者强行注射疫苗。

en.s: The Aberdeen South by-election of 1907 was held on 20 February 1907. The by-election was held due to the incumbent Liberal MP, James Bryce, being appointed British Ambassador to the United States. It was won by the Liberal candidate George Esslemont. Fred Bramley, who stood for the "Aberdeen Labour Representation Committee", was not officially endorsed by the Labour Party or the Scottish Workers' Representation Committee.

zh.s: 1907年2月20日，英国阿伯丁南选区举行补选，原因是原任自由党议员詹姆斯·布赖斯被任命为英国驻美国大使。自由党候选人乔治·埃斯勒蒙特获胜。另一名候选人弗雷德·布拉姆利代表“阿伯丁劳工代表委员会”参选，但未获工党或苏格兰工人代表委员会的正式支持。

en.s: The 1912 Chinese provisional presidential election were the elections held on 15 February and 20 February 1912 in Nanjing for the second provisional President and Vice President of China. After the Wuchang Uprising on 10 October 1911, Yuan Shikai, the powerful military officer was reappointed to lead the Beiyang Army by the Qing court. Yuan realized that Manchu's days were numbered and decided to establish a government himself.

zh.t: 1912年中华民国临时大总统选举
zh.s: 1912年2月15日和20日，南京举行选举，选出中华民国第二任临时大总统及临时副总统。1911年10月10日武昌起义后，清廷重新起用掌握重兵的袁世凯，让他统率北洋军。袁世凯意识到清朝统治已难以维持，决定自行掌权组建政府。

zh.t: 1915年卡斯尔里选区州议会补选
zh.s: 1915年2月20日，新南威尔士立法议会卡斯尔里选区举行补选，起因是工党议员约翰·特雷弗去世。

en.s: The 1920 Gori earthquake hit the Democratic Republic of Georgia on 20 February at 15:44 local time. The shock had a surface-wave magnitude of 6.2 and a maximum Mercalli Intensity of IX (Violent). Heavy damage (and between 114 and 130 deaths) affected the town of Gori and its medieval fortress.
en.n: This entry records the local date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1920年2月20日当地时间15时44分，格鲁吉亚民主共和国发生哥里地震。地震面波震级为6.2级，最高烈度为麦加利烈度IX级（剧烈）。哥里镇及其中世纪堡垒遭受严重破坏，死亡人数在114至130人之间。

en.s: The Clonmult ambush took place on 20 February 1921, during the Irish War of Independence. Irish Republican Army (IRA) volunteers occupying a farmhouse in Clonmult, County Cork were surrounded by a force of British Army, Royal Irish Constabulary and Auxiliaries. In the action that followed, twelve IRA volunteers were killed, four wounded and four captured.

zh.s: 1921年2月20日，爱尔兰独立战争期间发生克朗马尔特伏击战。占据科克郡克朗马尔特一座农舍的爱尔兰共和军志愿人员，被英国陆军、爱尔兰皇家警察及其辅助部队包围。在随后的交战中，12名共和军志愿人员死亡、4人受伤、4人被俘。

en.s: The Camberwell North by-election of 1922 was held on 20 February 1922. The by-election was held due to the resignation of the incumbent Coalition Conservative MP, Henry Newton Knights. It was won by the Labour candidate Charles Ammon.

zh.s: 1922年2月20日，英国坎伯韦尔北选区举行补选，填补联合政府保守党议员亨利·牛顿·奈茨辞职留下的空缺。工党候选人查尔斯·阿蒙当选。

en.s: General elections were held in Japan on 20 February 1928, the first after the introduction of universal male suffrage. The ruling Rikken Seiyūkai led by Prime Minister Tanaka Giichi won one more seat than the opposition Rikken Minseitō led by Hamaguchi Osachi, although Rikken Minseitō had received slightly more votes. The hung parliament led to the Tanaka government continuing in office.

zh.s: 日本于1928年2月20日举行大选，这是实行男性普选后的首次选举。首相田中义一领导的执政党立宪政友会，比滨口雄幸领导的反对党立宪民政党多赢得一个议席，但立宪民政党的总得票略高。议会没有任何政党取得多数，田中政府因此继续执政。

zh.s: 日本于1930年2月20日举行大选。首相滨口雄幸领导的立宪民政党取得众议院过半数议席。投票率为83.34%。

en.t: Workers and students occupy Encarnación in a revolutionary attempt
en.s: On February 20, 1931, workers and students occupied Encarnación, Paraguay, in an attempt to establish a libertarian commune. The occupation formed part of a wider revolutionary plan and lasted about16 hours.

zh.t: 工人和学生占领恩卡纳西翁，试图建立公社
zh.s: 1931年2月20日，一批工人和学生占领巴拉圭恩卡纳西翁，试图建立无政府主义公社。这是更大规模革命计划的一部分，占领持续了约16小时。

en.s: The Kumul Rebellion (Chinese: 哈密暴動; pinyin: Hāmì bàodòng; lit. 'Hami Uprising') was a rebellion from 1931 to 1934 of Kumulik Uyghurs who conspired with Hui Chinese Muslim General Ma Zhongying to overthrow Jin Shuren, the governor of Xinjiang Province. The Kumulik Uyghurs were loyal to the Kumul Khanate and wanted to restore the heir to the khanate and overthrow Jin.

zh.s: 哈密起义（中文：哈密暴动；拼音：Hāmì bàodòng）是1931年至1934年间哈密维吾尔人发动的起义。起义者与回族将领马仲英合谋，试图推翻新疆省长金树仁。哈密维吾尔人效忠哈密汗国，希望恢复汗国并拥立继承人。

en.s: General elections were held in Japan on 20 February 1932. They were the last elections before the May 15 Incident, which marked the temporary end of party politics in Japan. Rikken Seiyūkai won 301 of the 466 seats in the House of Representatives.

zh.s: 日本于1932年2月20日举行大选。这是“五一五事件”前的最后一次选举，该事件标志着日本政党政治暂时终结。立宪政友会在众议院466个议席中赢得301席。

en.t: US Congress proposes the Twenty-first Amendment
en.s: On February 20, 1933, the United States Congress proposed the Twenty-first Amendment to repeal nationwide Prohibition. The amendment was ratified on December 5 that year, so this entry records the proposal rather than repeal taking effect.

zh.t: 美国国会提出第二十一条宪法修正案
zh.s: 1933年2月20日，美国国会提出第二十一条宪法修正案，主张废除全国禁酒制度。修正案直到同年12月5日才获批准，因此此条记录的是国会提出修正案，而非禁酒令在当天废止。

en.t: Adolf Hitler secretly meets with German industrialists to arrange for financing of the Nazi Party's upcoming election campaign
en.s: The Secret Meeting of 20 February 1933 (German: Geheimtreffen vom 20. Februar 1933) was a secret meeting held by Adolf Hitler and 25 industrialists at the official residence of the President of the Reichstag Hermann Göring in Berlin. Its purpose was to raise funds for the election campaign of the Nazi Party. The German elections were to be held on 5 March 1933.

zh.t: 阿道夫·希特勒与德国工业家秘密会面，为纳粹党即将举行的竞选活动筹款
zh.s: 1933年2月20日秘密会议（德语：Geheimtreffen vom 20. Februar 1933）由阿道夫·希特勒和25名工业家在柏林举行，地点是国会主席赫尔曼·戈林的官邸。会议目的是为纳粹党的竞选活动筹款。德国大选定于1933年3月5日举行。

en.s: The 1937 Tasmanian state election was held on 20 February 1937 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 30 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — six members were elected from each of five electorates. The incumbent Labor government was led by Albert Ogilvie. The opposition Nationalist Party was led by Henry Baker.

zh.s: 1937年2月20日，澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州举行选举，选出州众议院30名议员。选举采用黑尔—克拉克比例代表制，五个选区各选出六名议员。在任工党政府由阿尔伯特·奥格尔维领导，反对党国民党由亨利·贝克领导。

en.s: The Louisiana gubernatorial election of 1940 was held in two rounds on January 16 and February 20, 1940. Like most Southern states between Reconstruction and the civil rights era, Louisiana's Republican Party was virtually nonexistent in terms of electoral support. This meant that the two Democratic Party primaries held on these dates were the real contest over who would be governor. The election resulted in the defeat of Earl K. Long and the election of Sam H. Jones as governor of Louisiana on a reform platform.

zh.s: 1940年路易斯安那州州长选举的两轮投票分别于1月16日和2月20日举行。从重建时期到民权运动时代，路易斯安那与多数美国南方州一样，共和党在选举中几乎没有支持基础，因此这两轮民主党初选实际上决定了州长人选。厄尔·K.朗落败，主张改革的萨姆·H.琼斯当选州长。

en.s: The Battle of Badung Strait was a naval battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II, fought on the night of 19/20 February 1942 in Badung Strait (not to be confused with the West Java city of Bandung) between the American-British-Dutch-Australian Command (ABDA) and the Imperial Japanese Navy. In the engagement, four Japanese destroyers defeated an Allied force that outnumbered and outgunned them, sinking the Dutch destroyer Piet Hein and escorting two transports to safety.

zh.s: 巴东海峡海战是第二次世界大战太平洋战场的一场海战，于1942年2月19日至20日夜间在巴东海峡爆发（不要与西爪哇城市万隆混淆）。交战双方是美英荷澳司令部（ABDA）和日本帝国海军。四艘日军驱逐舰击败人数和火力均占优势的盟军，击沉荷兰驱逐舰“皮特·海因”号，并护送两艘运输船安全撤离。

en.s: The action off Bougainville was a naval and air engagement on the South Pacific Theater of World War II near Bougainville, Papua New Guinea on 20 February 1942. A United States Navy aircraft carrier task force on its way to raid the Imperial Japanese military base at Rabaul, New Britain was attacked by a force of land-based bombers of the Imperial Japanese Navy.

zh.t: 布干维尔岛附近海空战
zh.s: 1942年2月20日，第二次世界大战南太平洋战区布干维尔岛附近发生海空战。美国海军一支航母特遣队正准备空袭新不列颠岛拉包尔的日本帝国海军基地，途中遭到日军岸基轰炸机攻击。

en.t: Rockwell’s Freedom of Speech appears in The Saturday Evening Post
en.s: On February 20, 1943, The Saturday Evening Post in the United States published Norman Rockwell’s Freedom of Speech, the first painting in his Four Freedoms series. The other three paintings appeared in subsequent weekly issues.

zh.t: 《星期六晚邮报》刊登洛克威尔的《言论自由》
zh.s: 1943年2月20日，美国《星期六晚邮报》刊登诺曼·洛克威尔的《言论自由》。这是其“四大自由”系列中最先刊登的一幅，其余三幅在随后几周陆续发表。

en.s: The Battle of Stężarzyce or Attack of Stężarzyce took place between the Ukrainian Insurgent Army and the Home Army in the Volyn Oblast, in Stężarycze, It took place on February 20, 1944.

Undertaken after landings to secure lodgments on New Britain and Bougainville, the main focus of the operation was the capture of Nissan Island, which was secured by New Zealand forces after only a short ground campaign.

zh.s: 绿岛群岛战役又称“方形钉行动”，于1944年2月15日至20日爆发，交战双方是日本帝国与新西兰第3师、美国组成的盟军。盟军先在新不列颠岛和布干维尔岛登陆并建立据点，随后以攻占尼桑岛为行动重点。新西兰部队只用很短时间便控制了尼桑岛。

en.s: Operation Argument, after the war dubbed Big Week, was a sequence of raids by the United States Army Air Forces and RAF Bomber Command from 20 to 25 February 1944, as part of the Combined Bomber Offensive against Nazi Germany. The objective of Operation Argument was to destroy aircraft factories in central and southern Germany in order to defeat the Luftwaffe before the Normandy landings during Operation Overlord were to take place later in 1944.

zh.s: “大周”行动战后被称为“大周”。1944年2月20日至25日，美国陆军航空军和英国皇家空军轰炸机司令部发动一系列空袭，属于盟军联合轰炸攻势的一部分。行动目标是摧毁德国中部和南部的飞机工厂，在1944年稍后的霸王行动（诺曼底登陆）前击败德国空军。

en.s: Mercury-Atlas 6 (MA-6) was the first crewed American orbital spaceflight, which took place on February 20, 1962. Piloted by astronaut John Glenn and operated by NASA as part of Project Mercury, it was the fifth human spaceflight, preceded by Soviet orbital flights Vostok 1 and 2 and American sub-orbital flights Mercury-Redstone 3 and 4.

zh.s: 水星-宇宙神6号（MA-6）是美国首次载人绕地轨道飞行，于1962年2月20日进行。任务由宇航员约翰·格伦驾驶，属于美国国家航空航天局的水星计划。这是人类第五次太空飞行，此前苏联已进行东方1号和东方2号轨道飞行，美国则进行了水星-红石3号和4号亚轨道飞行。

zh.s: 西澳大利亚州于1965年2月20日举行选举，改选立法议会全部50席，以及30席立法委员会中的15席。由州长戴维·布兰德爵士领导的自由党—乡村党联合政府击败反对党领袖阿尔伯特·霍克领导的工党，赢得第三个任期。

en.s: On 20 February 1968, the China Academy of Space Technology was established in Beijing, China. The institute became a major center for spacecraft research, development and production.

zh.t: 中国空间技术研究院成立
zh.s: 1968年2月20日，中国空间技术研究院在北京成立，后来成为中国航天器研究、研制和生产的重要机构。

en.s: Elections were held in the state of Western Australia on 20 February 1971 to elect all 51 members to the Legislative Assembly and 15 members to the 30-seat Legislative Council. The four-term Liberal-Country Party coalition government, led by Premier David Brand, was defeated by the Labor Party, led by Opposition Leader John Tonkin. en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 20 February 1972. The result was a victory for Arturo Armando Molina of the Party of National Conciliation (PCN), who received 43.4% of the vote. However, the election was characterised by massive fraud. The PCN had faced a strong challenge from left- and right-wing opposition, and as a result had tried to rig the election by holding the presidential elections two weeks before the legislative election (which took place on 12 March) to ensure that if Molina failed to pass the 50% mark, the Legislative Assembly would still be under PCN control to approve him as president.

zh.s: 萨尔瓦多于1972年2月20日举行总统选举。民族和解党的阿图罗·阿曼多·莫利纳以43.4%的选票获胜，但这场选举存在大规模舞弊。民族和解党面临左右两派反对力量的强劲挑战，试图通过提前举行总统选举来操控结果。议会选举定于3月12日，总统选举在其前举行，原文称提前“两周”。这样一来，即使莫利纳得票未超过50%，仍由民族和解党控制的议会也能批准他出任总统。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 20 February 1977. The result was a victory for Carlos Humberto Romero of the Party of National Conciliation, who received 67.3% of the vote. However, the election was characterised by massive fraud, with officials of the National Opposing Union (UNO, an alliance of the Christian Democratic Party, National Revolutionary Movement and Nationalist Democratic Union) intercepting military radio transmissions ordering ballot box stuffing, whilst their election officials were assaulted and ejected from polling stations. According to credible witnesses, in sixteen districts where an honest count was made, the UNO candidate, Ernesto Claramount Rozeville, won around 75% of the vote.

en.s: The First Nagorno-Karabakh War was an ethnic and territorial conflict that took place from February 1988 to May 1994 in the enclave of Nagorno-Karabakh in southwestern Azerbaijan between the majority ethnic Armenians of Nagorno-Karabakh backed by Armenia, and the Republic of Azerbaijan with support from Turkey. As the war progressed, Armenia and Azerbaijan, both former Soviet republics, entangled themselves in protracted, undeclared mountain warfare in the mountainous heights of Karabakh as Azerbaijan attempted to curb the Karabakh Movement. The enclave's parliament had voted in favor of uniting with Armenia and a referendum, boycotted by the Azerbaijani population of Nagorno-Karabakh, was held, in which a 99.89% voted in favor of independence with an 82.2% turnout. The demand to unify with Armenia began in a relatively peaceful manner in 1988; in the following months, as the Soviet Union disintegrated, it gradually grew into an increasingly violent conflict between Armenians and Azerbaijanis, resulting in ethnic cleansing, including the Sumgait (1988) and Baku (1990) pogroms directed against Armenians, and the Gugark pogrom (1988) and Khojaly Massacre (1992) directed against Azerbaijanis. Inter-ethnic clashes between the two broke out shortly after the parliament of the Nagorno-Karabakh Autonomous Oblast (NKAO) in Azerbaijan voted to unite the region with Armenia on 20 February 1988.

zh.t: 纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫第一次战争

en.s: The Station nightclub fire occurred on Thursday, February 20, 2003, in West Warwick, Rhode Island. The fire was caused by pyrotechnics set off by the tour manager of the evening's headlining band Great White, which ignited flammable sound insulation polyurethane foam in the walls and ceilings surrounding the stage. A fast-moving fire with intense black smoke engulfed the club in 5½ minutes. Video footage of the fire shows its ignition, rapid growth, the billowing smoke that quickly made escape impossible, and the exit blockage that further hindered evacuation. The toxic smoke, heat and the stampede of people toward the exits killed 100; 230 were injured and another 132 escaped uninjured.

en.s: A referendum on the treaty establishing a Constitution for Europe was held in Spain on 20 February 2005. en.s: The 2009 suicide air raid on Colombo was an unsuccessful kamikaze-style suicide attack launched by the air wing of the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam on February 20, 2009, targeting military locations in and around Colombo, Sri Lanka. It is speculated that the attacks were intended to be similar to the September 11 attacks, where aircraft were used as flying bombs and crashed directly into their targets. However the attacks failed as the Sri Lanka Air Force detected the two explosive packed aircraft and shot them down before they reached their targets.

en.s: On February 20, 2011, a state election was held in Hamburg, Germany, for the 20th legislative period of the Hamburg Parliament after World War II. The election is a result of the collapse of the coalition government led by the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) and the Green Alternative List (GAL). The Hamburg Parliament was officially dissolved on December 15, 2010. The Social Democratic Party (SPD) won an absolute majority after winning 62 seats. Absolute majorities are considered rare in Germany. The Free Democratic Party (FDP) re-entered parliament after failing to win any seats in the previous election.

en.s: The 2014 CAF Super Cup (also known as the 2014 Orange CAF Super Cup for sponsorship reasons) was the 22nd CAF Super Cup, an annual football match in Africa organized by the Confederation of African Football (CAF), between the winners of the previous season's two CAF club competitions, the CAF Champions League and the CAF Confederation Cup. en.t: Russia’s occupation of Crimea begins, in Ukraine’s official chronology
en.s: Ukraine’s official chronology dates the beginning of Russia’s occupation of the Crimean Peninsula to 20 February 2014. The seizure of the Crimean parliament and the subsequent annexation occurred later, as did Russia’s full-scale invasion in2022.
en.n: February20 is the officially recognized occupation start date in Ukraine’s chronology, not the date of every later military or annexation step.

zh.t: 按乌克兰官方时间线，俄罗斯开始占领克里米亚
zh.s: 乌克兰官方将2014年2月20日认定为俄罗斯开始占领克里米亚半岛的日期。夺取克里米亚议会、随后宣布吞并半岛，以及2022年的全面入侵，分别发生在之后的不同阶段。

en.t: Separatist forces take remaining positions near Debaltseve
en.s: On 20 February 2015, separatist forces captured remaining Ukrainian-held positions near Debaltseve in Ukraine, including Chornukhyne and several nearby villages. Most Ukrainian troops had withdrawn from the city on February 18.

en.s: On the night of February 20, 2016, a spree shooting took place at an apartment complex, a Kia car dealership, and outside a Cracker Barrel restaurant in Kalamazoo County, Michigan. Six people were killed, and two others were injured. Police detained a 45-year-old Uber driver, Jason Brian Dalton, in the shootings. He was subsequently charged with murder, assault, and criminal firearm use two days after the shootings.

en.s: The 72nd annual Berlin International Film Festival, usually called the Berlinale (German pronunciation: [bɛʁliˈnaːlə] ), took place from 10 to 20 February 2022 in person. On 15 December 2021, the first film of the festival was announced. The festival opened with François Ozon's drama film Peter von Kant. Isabelle Huppert was awarded Honorary Golden Bear for lifetime achievement on 15 February 2022 at the Berlinale Palast award ceremony.

en.s: On February 20, 2023, jihadists from the Islamic State – Sahil Province (ISGS) ambushed Burkinabe soldiers in Tin-Akoff, Oudalan Province, Burkina Faso. en.s: The 2025 Southern Somalia offensive (Somali: Weeraradii Shabeelle ee 2025ka), also known as Operation Ramadan (Somali: Hawlgalka Ramadaanka), was a military campaign in central Somalia, primarily in the Middle Shabelle, Lower Shabelle and Hiran regions, with periodic clashes in the Banaadir region. The offensive was launched by jihadist militant group al-Shabaab against the Somali National Army (SNA), African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) forces, and allied Ma'awisley clan militias. The group seeks to encircle the capital, Mogadishu, and regain territory lost in the 2022 Somali government / African Union offensive, particularly strategic towns and supply routes. The offensive began on 20 February 2025, with attacks on multiple positions of the Somali Armed Forces (SAF), including car bombs.
